A single-fascicle Liú-Sòng translation of a discourse on the eleven reflections (*anussati*) on the qualities of the Buddha. The Chinese parallel is T125[49.10].

T141 was produced during Guṇabhadra's Liú-Sòng career (435–468 CE), recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
